title: Rype's Auto Item Rename+Auction Seller
description: Automatically rename and sell large amounts of items with a single command. This mod is made especially for LifeStealSMP.com players, helping automate repetitive renaming and auction house selling tasks with configurable speeds and simple controls.
body:
# Rype's Auto Renamer & Auction Seller

Automate the tedious process of renaming and selling items. This client-side Fabric mod automatically renames items using a custom command and list them on the auction house with a specified price, making it much faster to process large amounts of items.
This mod is made especially for LifeStealSMP.com players, or any server that has both (/itemname and Auction house), helping automate repetitive renaming and auction house selling tasks with configurable speeds and simple controls.

## Features

- Automatically renames items using a custom rename command.  /rypein <colour code/name>
- Automatically sells items using a custom auction house command.  /rypesell <price>
- Processes the selected hotbar slot first, then the rest of your inventory.
- Configurable target hotbar slot (1–9).
- Separate speed settings for renaming and selling operations.
- Adjustable delays from 0.1 to 10.0 seconds.
- Simple configuration through Mod Menu.
- Client-side only.
- For LifeStealSMP.com Mostly.

## Commands

### Auto Rename
/rypein <colour code/name>

Example:
/rypein &#000fff&lR&#005ff0&ly&#00afe2&lp&#00ffd3&le / LEGENDARY

### Auto Auction Sell
/rypesell <price>

Example:
/rypesell 10

## Configuration

Available through Mod Menu:

- Hotbar Slot – Choose which hotbar slot the mod uses.
- Rename Speed – Delay between rename operations.
- Auction Sell Speed – Delay between sell operations.

## How It Works

1. Put the items you want processed in any of your 27 inventory slots <NOT INCLUDING HOTBAR>.
2. make sure the configured hotbar slot is empty.
3. Run the desired command.
4. The mod automatically:
   - Moves items into the configured hotbar slot.
   - Executes the rename or sell command.
   - Waits for the configured delay.
   - Continues until all eligible items are processed.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Fabric
- Requires servers that support custom rename commands and/or auction house commands.
- Command formats may vary between servers.

## Disclaimer

This mod automates inventory actions and command execution. Always ensure automation mods are allowed by the server you are playing on before using them.
